name: Gittyup
tagline: Graphical Git client designed to understand and manage your history
description: Gittyup is an open-source graphical Git client that continues the legacy of GitAhead, featuring fast branch trees, interactive staging, visual commit inspection, and commit squashing.
features: Fast interactive history log and topological branch viewer
Submodule management and conflict resolution visualizer
Lightweight C++ and Qt architecture with zero electron bloat
requirements: Linux x86_64, git installed on system
